description:
Hushfacebook 0.1.8 fixes the known issue from 0.1.7: Clean up Reels now takes the Follow button off reels on the Reels tab. It only caught the Following button next to people you already follow, so a reel from anyone else kept its Follow button. Following someone from their profile still works.

Checked on a signed-in test phone (Galaxy S22, Android 16) before release. With the switch on, no reel on the Reels tab showed a Follow button, and turning it off brought the button back.

All 22 patches applied without force to Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72, with no manifest changes. Local checks passed: 471 extension tests, 171 patch tests and both Android lints.

Requires Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a Facebook bundle. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK.
